}}'''Shimoku''' is an [[Accepted]] who was affiliated with the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Shimoku}}

== Appearance ==
She is pretty with dark eyes.

==Strength==
Shimoku is [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|very weak]] in the [[One Power]], with a strength level of {{opsl|40}}. This is marginally above [[Siuan Sanche]]'s strength after she was healed from [[Stilling|Severing]].

== Activities ==
Born in {{ne|973}}, she went to the Tower in {{ne|988}}.

She became an Accepted just before the split in the [[White Tower]] in {{ne|999}}. She is part of the [[Link]] controlled by [[Anaiya]], when the [[Bubble of evil]] erupts in [[Salidar]]. She entered the link easily; afterwards, she was so tired she sat down in the street to rest.
